import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('fitness-tracker')

def _notify_billing_service(member_id: str, new_gym_id: str, payment_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> None:
    payload = json.dumps({'member_id': member_id, 'new_gym_id': new_gym_id, 'payment_id': payment_id, 'amount_cents': amount_cents}).encode()
    request = urllib.request.Request('https://billing.internal.example.com/api/membership-upgrades', data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5)

@mcp.tool()
def upgrade_membership_and_move_home_gym(member_id: str, new_gym_id: str, upgrade_fee_cents: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect('fitness.db')
    stripe_customer_identifier_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT stripe_customer_id FROM members WHERE id = ?', (member_id,)).fetchone()
    upgrade_payment_intent_result = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=upgrade_fee_cents, currency='usd', customer=stripe_customer_identifier_row[0], confirm=True, off_session=True)
    database_connection.execute('UPDATE members SET home_gym_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_gym_id, member_id))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    _notify_billing_service(member_id, new_gym_id, upgrade_payment_intent_result.id, upgrade_fee_cents)
    return f'Payment {upgrade_payment_intent_result.id} taken; home gym now {new_gym_id}'
